issues.title: Known V551 repair debt is currently indistinguishable from unexplained missing atoms
issues.defect: V551J sees clean V551 atoms but has no canonical V551 repair companion. A directionally applicable response that was adjudicated nonpromotable can therefore surface as `MISSING_V551_ATOM_UNEXPLAINED`.
issues.evidence: Current V551J matching/review logic predates the repair surface.
issues.consequence: Known local evidence debt is misclassified as unexplained lineage failure and can escalate too broadly.
issues.required: Consume V551 adjudication/repair + distribution coverage alongside clean atoms. Exact missing atom with matching nonpromotable candidate becomes known local coverage debt.
tests: Known repair candidate → typed marginal/packet debt, not unexplained missing.
Failure remains local to smallest packet/marginal.

issues.title: Zero certified packets cannot be represented as a valid no-joint-evidence run
issues.defect: Current readiness/acceptance assumes a useful V551J run has certified packet rows; zero certified output tends to block the run rather than express typed absence/review-only evidence.
issues.evidence: Identified in V551J readiness and lineage requirements during hostile pass.
issues.consequence: Valid scopes with no certifiable joint evidence are conflated with compiler failure.
issues.required: Separate V551J run integrity from packet evidence sufficiency and emit a typed `NO_CERTIFIED_JOINT_EVIDENCE`/review-only state with valid empty schema when appropriate.
tests: Zero certified packets + valid inputs → integrity PASS, typed evidence state.

issues.title: V551J V551-atoms provenance check is tautological
issues.defect: The compiler computes the V551 atoms artifact hash from the supplied file and then uses that same computed value as the “expected governed hash” when checking the file.
issues.evidence: Hostile pass traced `required_input_hashes["v551_atoms_artifact_hash"] = file_hash(args.v551_atoms_path)` and later compares actual hash to that same value.
issues.consequence: The check proves only that the file did not change during execution, not that it is the producer-declared governed artifact.
issues.required: Read expected hashes/version from V551 manifest; compare actual atoms/adjudication/coverage files against producer-declared hashes.
tests: Tampered/substituted atom file fails against V551 manifest.

issues.title: V551J needs exact producer-version and local completeness semantics
issues.defect: The new V551 repair/coverage model changes what missing components mean. V551J must carry completeness at component/marginal/packet grain and reject incompatible producer contracts rather than infer globally from packet row counts.
issues.evidence: Existing V551J v2.2.3 predates the new V551 adjudication/coverage companions.
issues.consequence: Old/new artifacts can be mixed and local debt can be promoted to whole-wave failure.
issues.required: Version the V551J contract migration, carry local coverage/unresolved mass, and enforce exact supported V551 producer contract.
tests: Packet-local defect does not suppress unrelated packet.
